What does this Python print? Return the output only.
rows = [[0]] * 3
rows[1].append(4)
print(rows)
A Python function should count values above lo and at most hi. The loop currently uses 'if lo <= x < hi:'. Give only the corrected if line, preserving the variable names.

Give the two lines printed by this Python program.
it = iter([2, 4, 6])
print(next(it))
print(sum(it))
A stable sort of [('a', 2), ('c', 1), ('b', 2), ('d', 1)] uses only the numeric field as its ascending key. Return the resulting labels as four lowercase letters without spaces.

Tables bins(id) and items(bin_id, label) exist. bins has ids 4 and 9. items has (4, 'cap'), (4, 'pin') and no row for 9. After bins LEFT JOIN items ON bins.id = items.bin_id and GROUP BY bins.id, what is COUNT(items.label) for bins 4 and 9 in that order? Reply as two comma-separated integers.

What does this Python print? Return one line.
functions = [lambda n=n: n + 1 for n in range(3)]
print([f() for f in functions])
For Python re.findall(r'[A-Z]+[0-9]{2}', 'axF01 XY23 ab12 R7 V678'), give the resulting JSON array of strings.
Python data = [3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13]. What is data[-2:0:-2]? Return a JSON array.
In Python, how many bytes does 'café'.encode('utf-8') contain, where the é is U+00E9? Reply with one integer.
Four people stand in a row. Noor is immediately left of Ivo. Lio is last. Pia is somewhere left of Noor. Give the four names in order, separated by spaces.
A dye mix uses blue and yellow in the ratio 3:5. There are 48 ml already mixed. How many ml of yellow must be added to make the ratio 1:2? Give just the number.
Find the smallest positive integer that leaves remainder 3 when divided by 7 and remainder 5 when divided by 9. Return one integer.
An orchard has 12 rows of 8 trees. A quarter of the trees are pears. Of the remaining trees, one third are plums and the rest are apples. How many apple trees are there? Reply with a number.
Of 31 learners, 17 took pottery, 15 took weaving, and 6 took neither. How many took both pottery and weaving? Return one integer.
Undirected edges with distances are A-B=3, A-C=8, B-C=2, B-D=9 and C-D=1. Return the minimum distance from A to D as one number.
A 50 cm by 35 cm board is covered by identical square tiles with no cuts or gaps. Using the biggest possible squares with whole-centimeter sides, how many tiles are needed? Return one number.
A pouch contains five amber and three teal marbles. Two marbles are drawn uniformly without replacement. What is the probability both are teal? Give a simplified fraction.
A 52-minute workshop starts at 23:41 and has a separate 16-minute cleanup immediately afterward. At what time does cleanup finish? Reply in 24-hour HH:MM form.

Exactly one of three labeled boxes contains a key. The box labels make these claims: red says 'blue contains the key'; blue says 'green contains the key'; green says 'blue is empty'. Exactly two claims are true. Which box contains the key? Reply in lowercase.
便签写着：木匠周二送来三把椅子，周四取走一把。周四结束时还剩几把椅子？只回答一个阿拉伯数字。
「柿、桃、梨、桃、柿」という順でカードを並べました。左から三番目のカードに書かれた漢字一字だけを答えてください。
도서관은 월요일과 수요일에 쉽니다. 민수가 화요일, 수요일, 목요일 중 하루에 가려면 갈 수 있는 요일은 무엇인가요? 쉼표로 구분해 한국어로 답하세요.
في الصندوق سبع كرات حمراء وثلاث زرقاء. نقلنا كرتين حمراوين إلى صندوق آخر. كم كرة بقيت في الصندوق الأول؟ أجب برقم فقط.
सूची में चार रंग हैं: लाल, पीला, नीला, हरा। पीले के ठीक बाद कौन-सा रंग है? सिर्फ रंग का नाम लिखिए।
במדף העליון יש תשעה ספרים. מעבירים ארבעה מהם למדף התחתון ואז מחזירים אחד. כמה ספרים יש עכשיו במדף העליון? ענו בספרה אחת בלבד.
У майстерні є три стільці й п’ять табуретів. Два табурети забрали. Скільки предметів для сидіння залишилося? Напиши лише число.
Ordena por altura, de mayor a menor: el roble mide 9 m, el pino mide 14 m y el olmo mide 8 m. Devuelve los nombres únicamente, separados por comas.
Katika kikapu kuna maembe sita na mapera manne. Maembe mawili yameondolewa. Yamebaki maembe mangapi? Jibu kwa tarakimu moja tu.
Στη σειρά «ήλιος, βροχή, χιόνι, άνεμος» ποια λέξη βρίσκεται αμέσως πριν από το «χιόνι»; Γράψε μόνο τη λέξη.

Room Cedar is unavailable. The new room is Finch. Give the room and time as ROOM / HH:MM.

The starting inventory is 18 clips and 9 pins.

The title is ‘Fog at Noon’. Write a six-word line about a bridge, in the past tense.
The bridge vanished into pale fog.
Keep the other words and six-word count. Replace ‘vanished’ with ‘emerged’ and change the preposition ‘into’ to ‘from’. Give only the line.

expected: The bridge emerged from pale fog.

Starting from your last answer, add 21.
The informal project name is ‘Brook’. Its chosen release name is ‘Reed’.

Replace the informal name in this sentence with the release name and keep everything else: The Brook kit arrived today.

OPEN and CLOSED.

N7

Fern is the vase and Moss is the mug.
The vase is now called Rain. Which named object is still made of clay? Give its name alone.

copper, zinc, tin

tin, copper, zinc

Understood.

text: Receipt: kiln trays x3 @ 4.00; filter pads x2 @ 1.25; total 14.50. Extract the pad count and total charge in dollars as compact JSON with keys pads and total, in that order. Write the total with exactly two decimal places.

Extract the inclusive start and end dates as a compact JSON object with keys start and end in YYYY-MM-DD format: The reading room will be closed from Friday, April 3, 2026 until and including Monday, April 6, 2026.
Convert these fields to one standard CSV row without headers: item name = Glass, etched; quantity = 4; finish = satin. Quote a field only when required.
Known facts: Monarda is the label and six is the number of trays. The room is unavailable. Output compact JSON with label (string), trays (integer), room (null if unknown), in that order.
Normalize this list by trimming surrounding spaces, converting to lowercase, then keeping the first occurrence of each item. Output a JSON array: [" Fir ", "Oak", "fir", " Elm", " OAK "].
For a fictional exhibit, the gallery is Dome, the floor is 2, the section is B, and the cabinet is 07. Extract the location as GALLERY/FLOOR/SECTION/CABINET, preserving the leading zero.
Note: Opening balance +12. Entered movement: removed 3 units. Output JSON with delta (signed integer) and unit (string, singular), in that order. Only describe the movement.
Samples: Q8 | pass | 58; M2 | fail | 92; B5 | pass | 66; L1 | pass | 22. Keep passing samples with score strictly above 50. Output their IDs in descending score order as an array.
Return a JSON object whose only key is note and only value is the literal string The sign says "open". Do not include a code fence.
Find only the asset code from this record: title = Field Notes, rev = 003, asset = QV-01674, batch = QV-01675. Reply with the asset code alone.

Minutes: The group considered replacing the bench. The chair withdrew that proposal. The group approved refinishing the existing bench and will choose a stain in June. In one sentence, give the action that passed and the remaining decision.
expected: The group approved refinishing the bench and will choose a stain in June.

text: The demonstration begins at 14:00 in Room Alder. Check-in opens at 13:40 in the adjacent foyer. The optional tour was canceled. Write a single sentence for visitors that retains the start time, venue and check-in time.
expected: The demonstration starts at 14:00 in Room Alder, with check-in from 13:40 in the adjacent foyer.

text: A tray was tilted to the left, causing water to flow away from its right corner. When level, the same volume covers the bottom evenly. In one sentence, explain why the right corner was dry while tilted.
expected: Gravity moved the water toward the lower left side, leaving the higher right corner dry.

text: The craft room admits walk-ins until 16:00. After that, entry requires a reservation. The room closes at 18:00. A visitor with a reservation arrives at 17:10. State whether they may enter and why in one sentence.
expected: Yes, the visitor has the required reservation and arrives before closing.

text: Note A says the mural measures 4 m wide. Note B says the wall measures 6 m wide. Note C explicitly corrects the mural width to 5 m and leaves the wall measurement unchanged. Summarize both current widths in one sentence.
expected: The mural is 5 m wide and the wall is 6 m wide.

text: The east lamp went dark. The bulb worked when tested in the west socket. A working bulb placed in the east socket also stayed dark, and the east wall switch was off. Give the simplest supported explanation in a sentence.
expected: The east lamp had no power because the east wall switch was off.

text: Three rooms need paint. Fern needs 2 cans, Cove needs 4, and Moss needs 3. The group owns 5 unopened cans and intends to reuse them first. In one sentence, say how many more cans it needs and why.
expected: It needs 4 more cans because the rooms require 9 total and 5 are already available.

text: The printer was first reported broken. A loose tray was reseated, and a ten-page test then passed. The supplier has already shipped a spare tray. Write one sentence reporting the current printer status and one next event grounded in these facts.
expected: The printer passed the test after its tray was reseated, and a spare tray is on its way.

text: Two plaques read 'The clock was installed in 1921' and 'The tower opened in 1908'. The plaque dates describe distinct events. In one sentence, report the opening and installation dates with the correct labels.
expected: The tower opened in 1908, and the clock was installed in 1921.

text: Members can borrow four books. A temporary rule sets a limit of two science books per member while the science collection moves. The temporary rule leaves the total limit in place. In one sentence, say whether three science books and one novel can be borrowed together, and why.
expected: No, three science books exceed the temporary limit of two per member.

For a Unicode string of the single character 𝄞 (U+1D11E), how many bytes does UTF-8 encoding require? Reply with an integer.

document.heading: East stack accession record
document.fact: The first accession record identifies the archive seal as VEGA-517Q; the seal was pressed only once.
document.filler: The reading clerk logged a gray cover and straightened the stack. Reference copies of the inventory sit on the bottom shelf where returning staff can find them.
document.question: What is the archive seal shown in the first accession record? Return the seal alone.

document.heading: Handwritten display instructions
document.fact: The curator's response rule is to place the accession label after the direction, separate them with a slash, and capitalize both parts. The accession label is j67.
document.filler: A folded cloth protects the temporary display stand during cleaning. The design desk keeps a separate sample of the fabric in case a replacement is required next season.
document.question: The direction is west. Apply the curator's response rule using the accession label stored at the top. Output only the result.

document.heading: Tile workshop daybook
document.fact: The opening count for Studio Violet was 136 repaired tiles. Nothing had been shipped at opening.
document.filler: Each glazed sample rests on a short shelf and is labeled underneath. The shelf supports were sanded last winter, and the workshop keeps their color swatches nearby.
document.question: Using the opening count, add the 29 tiles repaired this afternoon and subtract the 17 that were shipped. Return the number of repaired tiles remaining.

document.heading: Garden feature caption record
document.fact: The museum's official feature caption is “Stone Bridges at First Light”. The draft cover described stonework more generally.
document.filler: This page discusses where the display boards are stored when the room is rearranged. Staff collect pieces of wrapping paper from the table before moving the boards.
document.question: Copy the approved feature caption from the opening record, preserving its capitalization and omitting quotation marks.

document.heading: Winter room allocation memo
document.fact: The opening memo reserves room Larch for quilters, room Aspen for paper cutters, and room Pine for sketchers. Each group has exactly one room.
document.filler: A runner checked open space on the walkway and collected stray materials. Spare stools were moved into the supply closet so the walkway would stay clear.
document.question: Quilters and paper cutters agree to swap their rooms. What room do the quilters use after the swap? Give only the room name.

document.heading: Library drawer marker guide
document.fact: The drawer labeled Rill uses box 14 for replacement cards. For this guide, write a restocking request as drawer label, then colon, then box number, with no spaces.
document.filler: The library wipes empty drawers with a dry cloth after shelving. Spare cloths stay in an unmarked cabinet, ready for the next shift to pick up.
document.question: Write the guide-compliant restocking request for the drawer described in the first entry. Give only the request.

document.heading: Grid survey notebook
document.fact: The survey team registered its first marker at row 19, column 6. Rows increase downward and columns increase to the right.
document.filler: During the walking survey the crew set down the empty cases to rest. Later the cases were brushed off and fitted into their rack for transport.
document.question: Start from the first marker. Move three rows down and two columns left. Return the final row and column as a JSON array.

document.heading: Borrowing-cart reconciliation
document.fact: The signed opening reconciliation lists 72 rulers, 56 pencils and 15 notebooks. All quantities count individual units.
document.filler: The shift opened with a review of the labels used on the cart dividers. People with large bags were asked to leave them in the vestibule.
document.question: Since opening, 9 of the category with the middle opening count were borrowed and 4 of that category were returned. Give the category and new count as CATEGORY=NUMBER in lowercase.

document.heading: Panel finishing worksheets
document.fact: The signed label for the finished sample is mQ8-nL2. Preserve uppercase and lowercase letters exactly when recording the label.
document.filler: The sample board was hung beside a tall window with its corners free of the frame. Protective paper was folded and stored in the drawer below it.
document.question: Transcribe the signed sample label from the opening worksheet. Return only that label, preserving case and punctuation.

document.heading: Field notebook — reference key
document.fact: The opening reference key pairs lantern with IRIS-204K, compass with ZEAL-731P, and bell with MICA-892V. The active entry is compass.
document.filler: On routine rounds the keeper checked that each display case was closed and laid out clean cloths. There were no changes to the reference key during this round.
document.question: Use the active entry named in the opening reference key to find its paired code. Reply with that code alone.
